summary: Full backend (pytest, 40 tests) + frontend (Playwright on public URL) verification of the new parent/child story-tree navigation, character-change transforms, story-completeness prompts and plain-English cast key. ALL requested features work. Backend: added TestConflictTreeEnrichment (is_beginning/is_ending, enriched lead/carry links with label/starts_story/leads_to_end/modifiers, no _id leak, link counts, dashed symbol descriptions) — all pass. Frontend verified with real clicks: /browse add-to-builder-1b -> /builder shows options-parent ABOVE (4 lead-ups) and options-child BELOW (4 carry-ons) the timeline (verified by bounding-box y ordering 596 < 883 < 1083); clicking option-child-139 appended it last, clicking option-parent-171 prepended it first, and both panels re-fetched for the new first/last conflict (#171 lead-ups, #139 carry-ons with 7 options + 'A-3 -> A-2' badges). Transform badge 'B -> A' renders in the lead-ups panel and on /conflict/1b. story-status listed all 4 items and flipped the A/C items to green after selecting clauses. cast-key/character-key listed A=Male Protagonist, A-2=Male Friend Of A, A-3=Male Rival Or Enemy Of A, B=Female Protagonist. /conflict/1b shows 'Parent situations · lead-ups (4)' / 'Child situations · carry-ons (4)' + character key; /conflict/259 shows no-lead-ups, /conflict/94a shows no-carry-ons; ref-link navigation works. Regression: dice -> Open in builder still prefills and shows panels + cast key; admin login with captcha works; save plot -> appears in /library (test plot deleted afterwards).

minor.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: lockout path raised 500 (TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes) because Mongo returns naive locked_until. Added tzinfo normalisation in /app/backend/auth.py; now returns 429 after 5 failures. Suite re-run: 40/40 pass.

issues: CSS 'capitalize' title-cases every word, so descriptions read 'Male Friend Of A' / 'Male Rival Or Enemy Of A' — capitalise only the first letter (first-letter or sentence-case) for readable English.

Key is built only from permutation text, so symbols visible in the lead-up/carry-on cards (A-2, A-8, F-B, B-5) are not explained on that page. Consider including link labels in the key texts so every symbol shown on screen is translated.
Console noise: two 401 responses on every page load (auth bootstrap /auth/me + refresh) for anonymous visitors — harmless but should be swallowed/short-circuited when no session cookie exists.

action_items: Optional polish: fix 'capitalize' title-casing in CharacterKey descriptions.
Optional: include lead-up/carry-on labels in the ConflictDetail CharacterKey texts so all displayed symbols are explained.
Optional: avoid 401 console errors for anonymous page loads.
Review the tester's one-line tz fix in /app/backend/auth.py login lockout.
critical_code_review_comments: Builder fetches full conflict detail for firstId and lastId on every change — fine now, but two effects duplicate identical logic; could be one helper. When first==last it fires two identical requests.
OptionsPanel flattens all groups' links and drops the group 'mode' (include all / choose one) that ConflictDetail shows; users adding a link from a 'include all' group lose that instruction.
addConflict/prependConflict silently no-op when the ref already exists in the draft (returns d) — clicking such an option shows a success toast but nothing is added. Consider a warning toast.
Builder.js is ~475 lines and growing; consider extracting OptionsPanel/ClausePicker/StoryStatus into components.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted plot 'TEST_QA_tree_plot' under admin@plotto.app; register-flow test users created by pytest fixtures.
test_credentials: admin@plotto.app / PlottoAdmin123 — UI login with captcha verified.

Useful ids: add-to-builder-<id>, options-parent/options-child, option-parent-<ref>/option-child-<ref>, status-item-0..3, cast-key + char-key-<symbol>, no-lead-ups (#259), no-carry-ons (#94a). Login ids are login-email-input/login-password-input/captcha-answer-input/login-submit-button (NOT login-email). Dataset: 5 conflicts have no lead-ups (259,303,312,842b,920) and 44 have no carry-ons (94a,167a,...). Wait ~3s after /builder navigation for the detail fetches.
rca_of_the_issue: Login lockout 500: pymongo/motor returns naive datetimes; comparing stored locked_until with datetime.now(timezone.utc) raised TypeError, surfacing as 500 for the 6th+ failed login. Fixed by normalising tzinfo to UTC before comparison.
